description: Illustrative research thresholds; team review required. Not bank approval or regulatory certification.
decision_threshold_note: The legacy notebook's own cut-off; at 0.5 only 1-2% of applicants are flagged and the fairness check measures almost nothing.
expected_signs_note: Credit-risk intuition: more utilisation, debt and past-due events raise default risk; older applicants default less in this population. A wrong sign is a conceptual-soundness finding, not proof of error.
